Third-party libraries bundled for local processing of answer keys:

SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 (Apache-2.0)
https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
License: LICENSE-SheetJS.txt

jsQR 1.4.0 (Apache-2.0)
https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
Published npm distribution: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jsqr@1.4.0/dist/jsQR.js
License: LICENSE-jsQR.txt

Files are served by the application; workbook and QR images are processed in
the browser. Only selected, confirmed answer keys are sent to the PHP backend.
